name: 03_multi_column_bleed
description: Two-column layout where Tesseract merges adjacent columns onto the same OCR line, separated by a large whitespace gap (e.g. 'PO Number: GR-30182          Delivery Date: 02/05/2026'). Without column-gap-aware splitting, a naive right-of-label regex grabs the next column's label+value as garbage.
represents: OCR column bleed — a known, recurring artefact of multi-column invoices/POs/statements (not specific to one supplier's layout). Guards the column-gap splitting fix referenced in CLAUDE.md/keyword.py.
